definitions.uncovered: Fewer than half the reference block pixels hit any exported block.
definitions.same_axis: Most pixels covered and majority of covered pixels hit the reference face axis at another coordinate.
definitions.different_axis: Most pixels covered and majority of covered pixels hit another face axis.
definitions.uncovered_stage: Furthest mask/count stage agreeing on at least half the reference block pixels. These are associations, not proven causes.
definitions.optional: Horizontal-only block with no native 4x4 square on a visible face.
